purpose: Reclaim exact duplicate immutable local regular-file storage by atomic hardlink replacement.
scope: Only six old immutable toolchain roots in retained plan were applied. No active formal toolchain, .lake cache, archive, Git ref or source/proof/governance edit.
self_verification: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_cbz_storage.py -v; python -O -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_cbz_storage.py -v
semantics: Immutable inputs only. File inode identity/link counts intentionally change; hardlinks share subsequent writes and inode metadata. Original per-path identities and timestamps retained in plan; distinct per-file mtime is not a preserved criterion.
recovery: Every pathname and byte sequence still exists. To undo sharing, copy an individual path through a new temporary regular file and atomically replace it, restoring recorded mode/ownership/timestamps as appropriate; requires space for independent copies.
limitations: Available-byte delta is observed filesystem-wide statvfs, so concurrent allocations can affect attribution. Checks establish storage behavior only; no mathematical/kernel certification.

archive_extension.selection: --archives-only; selected regular archives >1MiB with suffix .zip/.tar/.tar.gz/.tgz/.tar.zst/.deb/.xz; excludes symlinks, .git/.lake, any path component containing cache
archive_extension.authorization: Root concrete GO for exact plan SHA660ce0eebb527260de7c77080fab6e386079d21052e81f87a754c5a7904ff467,251 operations,487 selected archives; no broader scope.
archive_extension.post_apply: Full selected-file inventory bytes/paths/modes/ownership and all replacement pair inode identities verified.
